title: CardDemo Account Statements Extract (DJ-102)
description: Shared contract between the CBSTM04C COBOL batch JSON extract and the statement viewer. Locked for DJ-102: do not change. Amounts are signed decimals in dollars (converted from COMP-3/zoned-decimal, no overpunch characters).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the extract was produced, e.g. 2026-08-24T09:00:00Z

name.description: CUST-FIRST-NAME + CUST-MIDDLE-NAME + CUST-LAST-NAME, single-space separated, trailing blanks trimmed, empty middle name omitted

address.description: Address lines in order: CUST-ADDR-LINE-1, CUST-ADDR-LINE-2, CUST-ADDR-LINE-3, then 'STATE COUNTRY ZIP' (CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD, CUST-ADDR-COUNTRY-CD, CUST-ADDR-ZIP). Blank lines are omitted.

currentBalance.description: ACCT-CURR-BAL (PIC S9(10)V99) in dollars, signed, 2 decimal places

creditLimit.description: ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT (PIC S9(10)V99) in dollars, signed, 2 decimal places

transactions.description: All transactions for the account's card(s), in transaction file order

totalDebits.description: Sum of all positive transaction amounts (charges) for the statement, >= 0, 2 decimal places

totalCredits.description: Absolute value of the sum of all negative transaction amounts (payments/credits) for the statement, >= 0, 2 decimal places

amount.description: TRAN-AMT (PIC S9(09)V99) in dollars, signed (positive = debit/charge, negative = credit/payment), 2 decimal places
